interface.title: TOF-SIMS データ解析アプリ (TOF-SIMS Analyzer v1.0, Streamlit)
interface.field: Surface analysis / time-of-flight secondary ion mass spectrometry (TOF-SIMS)
interface.stage_of_work: Exploratory analysis after acquisition: comparing spectra across samples and exporting results for downstream use
interface.what_it_is_for: Load several TOF-SIMS mass spectra, put them on one binned m/z axis, normalize and scale them, and compare samples with overlays, a two-sample difference spectrum, PCA and hierarchical clustering, then export CSVs.

data.note: Most work used the built-in demo (?demo=1): six synthetic spectra, demo_A1–A3 (Si-rich) and demo_B1–B3 (PDMS-contaminated, m/z 73 marker). The two uploaded test files (sample_positive_spectrum.csv and sample_negative_spectrum.csv) also parsed and aligned, giving 2 samples and 102 bins, and the difference spectrum worked on them. Opening / without demo shows an empty-state prompt (screens/047.webp). Checking デモデータを使用 while files are uploaded keeps the uploads (still 2 samples; screens/053.webp). With only two samples, the PCA and HCA tabs both stop with a StreamlitInvalidMinMaxError. The UI is in Japanese. st.dataframe tables render (the pyarrow problem is fixed).

screens_never_reached: PCA and HCA tabs with the uploaded test files: both show StreamlitInvalidMinMaxError (主成分数 slider min = max = 2 when only 2 samples are loaded, app.py line 410), which also stops the HCA tab (screens/051.webp, screens/052.webp)
Sample-distance heatmap in 主要m/z（列） mode: none was shown in that mode
not_done: PCA/HCA on the uploaded files: blocked by the 2-sample slider error. Uploaded files also replace the demo data rather than adding to it, so no third sample could be added.

Dead end in the difference task (t7): the built-in 'Download as CSV' icon on the 差分上位ピーク table did not produce a file in this browser (screens/059.webp), so the peak list was not exported. The app has no dedicated export button for it.
The aligned CSV export contains raw counts only. The app gives no way to export normalized or scaled data, loadings or the HCA result.
The 規格化 control offers only なし and TIC規格化. Mean-centering, autoscaling and Poisson scaling are under スケーリング and change only PCA/HCA, not the overlay (screens/011.webp).
Overlay y-axis label still reads [TIC規格化] when normalization is なし (screens/012.webp). The matplotlib dendrogram shows tofu boxes in place of Japanese title and axis text (no CJK font).
Did not try the 0.1 Da bin width, the cosine and cityblock distances, or complete and single linkage, to stay within about 100 actions.
After isolating demo_A1 by double-clicking the legend, a single click on demo_B1 did not bring it back (screens/062.webp). Not explored further.
